questions.question: The float32 order of Painter's source-over onto a partly covered backdrop was not identified (quantisation-thirds: 5 of 16 RGB32F/L32F values off by 2^-25..2^-24 against r1; group-masks s2-s3: 20 631 RGB32F and 57 RGB16 values off by one export step). Do you accept a register entry for this residual, or keep it a divergence until the diagnostic recording of the report is made?
questions.context: Decision 044 and parity/reports/phase1/compositor-float32-residual.md: the sRGB8 part (binary16 coverage) and the plain 32-bit float uniform operand were found and ship as profile painter-12.1-isolated-half-alpha; the remaining float32/RGB16 residual survived thousands of tested float32 orderings, including Vulkan and D3D12 division measured on the recording GPU. No shipped template uses RGB32F/L32F; RGB16 masked groups are affected (57 of 196 608 values). Under decision 032 an r1 mismatch is never a pass without an owner-approved register entry.

options.label: Keep as divergence, record the diagnostic golden
options.description: exactness stays the goal; blocks any gate that uses masked RGB16/RGB32F partial coverage until resolved

options.label: Register an exception bounded by the published residuals
options.description: unblocks later gates now; accepts a known one-step difference on RGB16 and RGB32F partial coverage

questions.recommended: Keep as divergence, record the diagnostic golden
questions.answer: Keep as divergence, record the diagnostic golden
questions.answeredBy: coordinator (owner delegated decisions to Claude + model panel, 2026-10-11); an exception register entry would need the owner signature anyway (decision 032), and exactness is the acceptance rule
